html:
SMTO-WEB-0054 — The PDF download was stopped

GUID: b25ad25b-cf5f-58e9-8780-f4536c6bd2b3
Slug: web-document-cancelled
Domain: WEB · Subsystem: web_research

What happened

  • The task was stopped while SMTO was downloading a PDF, so the download ended early. SMTO didn't keep the unfinished file.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Check whether you or someone else selected Stop current task; if so, this message is expected. Stopping a task also stops any download that was still running.
  2. Don't rely on anything from that PDF in SMTO's answer. The file was never fully downloaded, so SMTO has no complete copy to quote from.

What success looks like

  • The task shows as stopped, and its answer doesn't quote the unfinished PDF.

If it still fails

  • If the download stopped even though nobody stopped the task, select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. SMTO won't restart the download on its own.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • PDF acquisition was cancelled (cancel event set, or the artifact store reported artifact_cancelled) during transfer, decompression or registration; the incomplete download was discarded and nothing was published.

What this means

  • The PDF acquisition cancellation callback fires during transfer, decompression or artifact registration. The diagnostic adds no retrieval. Read outcomes and retained receipts determine what evidence is available; an error does not establish the content of an unread source.

Why this can happen

  • The PDF acquisition cancellation callback fires during transfer, decompression or artifact registration.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect cancellation and the retained artifact outcome before starting any replacement transfer.

How to fix it

  • web/documents.acquire() observes context['cancel_event'] (or ArtifactStore raises artifact_cancelled) during streaming, decompression or register_chunks; staging is discarded. Do not restart the acquisition automatically; a deliberately resumed active task must acquire a complete document through normal controls.
  • Resume only when the task is active. Incomplete downloads are not published.

Retry and execution caution

  • Resume only when the task is active. Incomplete downloads are not published.

How to verify the fix

  • A deliberately resumed active task obtains a complete registered document through normal controls.

What not to do

  • Do not restart a cancelled acquisition automatically or claim its partial data is a completed document.

Technical notes

  • The diagnostic adds no retrieval. Read outcomes and retained receipts determine what evidence is available; an error does not establish the content of an unread source.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
